invariants.rationale: It is expected that execute() returns a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata object upon successful completion.
The HoodieWriteMetadata should have a non-null list of WriteStatus as its core data.
A commit typically results in at least one WriteStatus, so the result list should not be empty.
Each WriteStatus in the list should be non-null to represent valid write outcomes.
It is common for commits to ensure all WriteStatus instances represent successful operations.
